How winners are picked

Fair by design, checkable by anyone.

  • 1
    Snapshot at the top of the hour

    Every holder's balance is recorded. Pools and the dev wallet are excluded.

  • 2
    Odds match your share

    Hold 1% of supply, get a 1% chance. No minimum to enter.

  • 3
    Random pick from the blockchain

    The winner is drawn from a recent Solana block hash, so nobody can pick it.

  • 4
    Logged in public

    Every draw shows up in Winners with the wallet, item and delivery status.

FAQ

Questions people ask

Where does the vault's money come from?

Creator fees from $ROVAULT trades. Every buy and sell pays a small fee, and all of it goes to buying Limiteds and Robux.

How are items valued?

By RAP from Rolimons, the price Roblox traders already use. Every item in the vault shows its RAP so anyone can check it.

What's the grand drop?

Once a day the most valuable Limited in the vault goes to one holder. Same draw rules as the hourly opening.

Do I need to do anything to enter?

Just hold $ROVAULT and link your Roblox username. If you win before linking, your prize waits for you.

How is $ROVAULT launching?

Fair launch on pump.fun. No presale. Only trust the CA posted on this site.

Is this made by Roblox?

No. RoVault is a fan project and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Roblox Corporation.
